info.name: EduNest API — Current (Auth + Super-Admin)
info.description:
# EduNest API — Manual Testing Collection

Covers **all currently implemented routes** (`backend/src/app.ts`):

- `GET /api/health`
- `POST /api/auth/admin-request`, `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/refresh`, `/api/auth/logout`, `GET /api/auth/me`
- `GET /api/super/requests`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/approve`, `POST /api/super/requests/:id/reject`
- `POST /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes`, `GET /api/super/institutes/:id`, `PATCH /api/super/institutes/:id/status`

> NOTE: Admin / Teacher / Student / Classes / Timetable / Attendance / Tests / Fees / Salary / Notices / Complaints / Reports routes from `backendplan.md` are **NOT implemented yet** — so they are intentionally NOT in this collection.

## Setup (2 min)

1. Start backend: `cd backend` then `npm run dev` (expects `PORT=4000`, MongoDB running, `backend/.env` filled — see `backend/.env.example`).
2. Import this file into Postman: **Import → File → EduNest.postman_collection.json**.
3. Select collection → **Variables** tab → set:
   - `baseUrl` = `http://localhost:4000/api`
   - `superEmail` = your `SUPER_EMAIL` from `backend/.env` (default in `.env.example` is `super@edunest.in`)
   - `superPassword` = your `SUPER_PASSWORD` (default in `.env.example` is `Super@123`)
4. Cookies: Postman saves `edunest_token` + `edunest_refresh` (httpOnly) automatically. Keep **Cookie Jar enabled** (Postman does this by default). Login once, then all `Super` + `Me` requests work.
5. Follow the **suggested order** below (folder order = workflow order).

## Suggested manual flow

1. `Health` → should be `{ ok: true, data: { service, db, time } }`.
2. `Auth / 01 + 02 Admin Request` → creates 2 pending schools. Test scripts auto-save `instituteId` and `rejectInstituteId`.
3. `Auth / 04 Login Super-Admin` → sets cookies (also returns `{ user }`).
4. `Super Requests / List Pending` → see your 2 new rows, copy `instituteId` if needed.
5. `Super Requests / Approve` → approves `{{instituteId}}`.
6. `Super Institutes / Direct Create` → offline onboarding, auto-saves new `{{instituteId}}` + `tempPassword` (returned ONCE).
7. `Super Institutes / Directory + Detail + Status` → block/unblock/suspend/unsuspend cycle.
8. `Auth / Me, Refresh, Logout` → session checks.

All success bodies use envelope `{ ok: true, data: ... }`. Errors use `{ ok: false, error, details? }` with `400/401/403/404/409/429`.

request.description: Public liveness probe. No auth. Expect `{ ok: true, data: { service: 'edunest-api', db, time } }`.

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Run in order 01 → 09. Login as super-admin once; cookies auth the rest.

request.description: Public. Creates Institute(status=pending) + User(admin,status=pending). Returns `{ instituteId, status: 'pending' }`. Test script saves `instituteId`. Re-run with a fresh email (duplicate email → 409).

request.description: Negative test: bad email + short password + missing schoolName → 400 with zod details. Proves validator wiring.

Public (rate-limited: 10/min portal, 5/min console via X-Client). Body identifier = email OR loginId. Sets httpOnly cookies `edunest_token` (15min) + `edunest_refresh` (7d). Update `superEmail/superPassword` collection variables from your backend/.env first.
Negative test: admin from request 01/02 logs in BEFORE approval → 403 'Account pending approval'. After approval this same body returns 200.
Negative test: valid identifier + wrong password → 401 'Invalid credentials' (generic, no user enumeration).

Auth required (cookie). Returns `{ user, banner: { adminSuspended, instituteStatus } }`. Super-admin gets `instituteStatus: 'none'`. No status gate here by design so frontends can render pending/suspended banners.
Auth via refresh cookie. Reads `edunest_refresh`, rotates it, re-sets both cookies, returns `{ user }`. Old refresh token is invalidated (reuse → 401). Works even if access token expired.
Clears both cookies + revokes stored refresh hash server-side. Run LAST — after this, Super requests return 401 until you re-login (04).

item.name: 02 Super - Approval Queue
item.description: All require super-admin cookie (login 04 first). `protect → allowRoles(super-admin) → checkStatus`.

request.description: Default queue view. `GET /api/super/requests?status=pending`. Shows institute + requesting admin profile only — no student/teacher data.
Already-approved queue. `?status=active`. After approving, your Sunrise row moves here.
Rejected queue. Note: rejected = institute stays pending + admin=rejected (record preserved), filtered on admin row.
Sets Institute=active + Admin=active, writes AuditLog. Idempotent (re-approve → same 200). Uses `{{instituteId}}` auto-saved from Auth/01. Replace `:id` with a real ObjectId from the pending list.
Body `{ reason (min 3 chars) }`. Only pending can be rejected. Already-approved → 400 'use block-admin instead'. Uses `{{rejectInstituteId}}` auto-saved from Auth/02.
Negative test: malformed ObjectId → 400 'Invalid id format' (not 500). Unknown-but-valid ObjectId → 404.

item.name: 03 Super - Institutes Directory
item.description: Counts-only directory — never returns student/teacher PII, marks, fee rows, or complaint bodies.

request.description: Super-admin creates ACTIVE institute + admin directly (no approval). Returns `{ instituteId, adminEmail, tempPassword }` — tempPassword shown ONCE. Test script saves `instituteId` + `tempPassword`. Duplicate adminEmail → 409.

exec: console.log('Saved tempPassword (copy now, shown once):', json.data.tempPassword);

request.description: Directory rows: `school, code, admin(name/email), #students, #teachers, #classes, feesCollected%, complaintCounts, status, createdAt`. Aggregations only.
Demo of `?search` (matches name/code, regex-safe) + `?status=active`. Try status=pending|suspended, search=GREENWOOD. Invalid status → 400.
One-school counts + admin profile. Uses `{{instituteId}}`. Verifies no PII leak.
Default action: only admin suspended (status=suspended). Teachers/students keep logging in + portal shows 'Admin suspended' banner. Body `{ action, reason (min 3 chars, audited) }`.
Restores admin instantly. Same endpoint, `action: unblock-admin`.
Emergency only: `Institute.status=suspended` → EVERY login for that institute (admin/teacher/student) → 403 'School suspended'. Confirm explicitly before running on real data.
Restores institute instantly. Run after Suspend School to leave demo data clean.
